recommendation.damage_data: Per-node hit window/data editor values HPDamage/StaminaDamage, finite nonnegative. Use one common editor-selected instant damage GE instead of duplicate per-node GE classes
recommendation.effect: One instant GE with additive negative HP and Stamina SetByCaller modifiers; source ASC context contains Attacker and SourceObject, with actual hit result when available
recommendation.target_checks: Current scope: valid AKZMonster, target ASC/GetSet, HasAuthority on source, target MaxHP>0 and HP>0, owner ignored. MaxHP=0 means uninitialized rather than confirmed Dead state
recommendation.guard: Only for explicitly blockable hit: TryGuardHit before damage GE; true means omit HP and avoid second Stamina deduction; false does not mean GuardBreak exists
recommendation.result: Use WasSuccessfullyApplied for instant GE success rather than requiring persistent valid effect handle. Response, if introduced, happens after both modifiers finish; do not emit death from individual AttributeSet callbacks
recommendation.cleanup: Dedup state and scheduled sampling belong to current node/Ability and reset on node transition, End/cancel, natural completion, failed start, UnPossess and EndPlay. After GE callbacks recheck current Ability/node before further samples
